title: exportONNXNetwork
summary: Report unsupported ONNX export with a deterministic error.
description: `exportONNXNetwork` is registered but ONNX graph serialization and trained-network execution metadata remain outside this slice.
behaviors: The builtin returns a deterministic unsupported-export error without materializing inputs.
ONNX operator mapping, file writing, and trained-network graph serialization remain future work.

examples.output: RunMat reports that ONNX export is not yet implemented.

gpu_residency: ONNX export is host serialization work, but it depends on trained-network metadata that remains future work.
